text:
alex: FYI kicking off a hosted API roadmap thread for Q3 planning — main asks: chat latency improvements, embeddings cost targets, and a rerank throughput bump. need scope tradeoffs and launch criteria.

morgan: thanks. can we list non-negotiables vs stretch? customers won't accept >250ms median on short-chat paths.

priya: +1. also customers want 10-15% embedding cost reduction for high-volume pipelines. that's a hard ask from one of our top 3 beta accounts.

jamie: re: rerank—SLA is 500 qps for the 2x model variant, but engineering says current pipeline saturates at ~350 qps. needs either kernel optimizations or sharding.

azch: (typo) zach: Spoke with runtime team — three levers: batching tuning, KV prefix cache, and model quantization. each has perf vs quality tradeoffs.

alex: propose we define launch criteria per product slice:
- chat: median p50 < 250ms for <=128 tokens, p99 < 800ms, fallback to smaller model variant under overload
- embeddings: unit cost -15% vs baseline for 512-d embeddings in our benchmarks
- rerank: 95th perc latency < 700ms at target QPS or documented degraded mode

morgan: can we attach measurable signal sources? e.g., synthetic perf harness, customer trace set, and nightly regression jobs.

priya: yes. add these as gating checks. Also require automated evals on our customer prompt suite and threshold that quality drop <= 1.5% relative F1 on rerank.

jamie: what about rollout policy? a canary that starts at 1% then 10% then 50% over 48 hours? we should include automatic rollback on latency/error regressions.

azch: runtime shared a quick canary config idea:

```
canary:
  steps: [1, 10, 50]
  watch_window: 48h
  metrics:
    - latency_p50
    - latency_p99
    - error_rate
    - token_cost
  rollback_rules:
    - latency_p99 > baseline * 1.4 for 15m
    - error_rate > baseline + 0.5%
```

morgan: looks good. question: do we make quantization opt-in or default? opting-in reduces risk but fewer cost wins.

priya: recommend default for Dedicated customers only, opt-in for Hosted until we get 2 weeks of quality telemetry. customers are sensitive to hallucination changes.

alex: dependencies list: runtime perf kernels (eng-runtime), model quant profiles (eng-ml), cost telemetry (eng-platform), rollout UI + API (console), docs + migration notes (devex).

jamie: timeline ask: engineering says kernel work 3 sprints, quant profiles 2 sprints, rollout infra 1 sprint — parallel mostly, target soft-launch in 8 weeks if no blockers.

zach: we should add a storage/caching checklist: prefix cache hit target 60% for conversational workloads to hit token cost goals.

priya: OKR mapping proposal:
- Objective: Reduce inference unit economics friction for customers.
  - KR1: Hosted embeddings cost -15% for top-5 models (measured by token-cost metric)
  - KR2: Chat median latency p50 <= 250ms (short sequences)
  - KR3: Rerank 95th perc latency < 700ms at 80% of projected QPS

alex: +1. also add an adoption metric for quantized models (percent of routed requests) as a secondary KR.

jamie: blockers to call out in roadmap doc: model-quality regressions, limited perf benchmarks for long contexts, and console rollout UX for per-customer opt-in.

morgan: action items—who owns what?
- runtime perf & canary infra: @zach
- quant profiles + eval harness: @priya
- cost telemetry and dashboards: @morgan
- console rollout and docs: @jamie
- PM owner for slice: @alex

zach: acknowledged. I'll add an ETA for a perf spike test harness and share a short runbook for rollback conditions.

release-bot: deploy scheduled: perf-harness/202-quick-run on 1912345705 by zach — status: queued

priya: one more nuance — embeddings for similarity search often re-use cached vectors; careful how we measure unit cost. we'll include end-to-end pipeline tests with cache warmup.

morgan: ok let's draft the roadmap brief and circulate by EOD tomorrow. include the gating checklist, canary config, KRs, and customer-impact notes. I'll collect customer asks into a separate appendix.

alex: perfect. if no objections, I'll convert this thread into the roadmap doc outline and ping eng leads for estimates. :thumbsup:

jamie: no objections. thanks everyone.
